selected_evidence.summary: Rules were saved and reloaded successfully. After restart, firewalld was active/enabled and runtime rules matched permanent rules.
The public zone permanently allows SSH, and both node2 and node3 received the OpenSSH banner after node1 restarted.
The ordered ACCEPT rule targets only 10.100.203.11. Node2 received HTTP 200 before and after restarts; final packet counters recorded accepted traffic.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and all other sources
selected_evidence.summary: Node3 received immediate connection refusal before and after its restart. Catch-all IPv4 and IPv6 REJECT rules are active and permanent; IPv4 rejection counters recorded traffic.

Baseline boot ID 73bafeef-b823-49b3-8e3d-17981e865b31; restart acknowledged; new boot ID 93234dde-7171-487c-bfc4-25c9fd9a1dec. SSH, firewalld, persistent rules, node2 allowance, and node3 rejection recovered.
Baseline boot ID d72bd4ec-4e55-42df-9c71-99b4f4ace0ec; restart acknowledged; new boot ID dc0e5c8b-b02e-4d9d-9174-eb6305070ab3. SSH recovered and node2 retained permitted TCP/9000 access.
